changes.name: SkyboundOrbRewards
changes.source:
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local folders={
 workspace.SkyboundMap:FindFirstChild("SkyCoins"),
 workspace.SkyboundMap.WaterfallIsles:FindFirstChild("WaterfallCoins"),
 workspace.SkyboundMap.DesertTemple:FindFirstChild("DesertCoins"),
 workspace.SkyboundMap.FrozenPeaks:FindFirstChild("FrozenCoins"),
 workspace.SkyboundMap.VolcanoRealm:FindFirstChild("Orbs"),
 workspace.SkyboundMap.CelestialCity:FindFirstChild("Orbs"),
 workspace.SkyboundMap.VoidRealm:FindFirstChild("Orbs")
}
local busy={}
local function hook(orb)
 if not orb:IsA("BasePart") then return end
 orb.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
  local p=Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent);if not p or busy[orb] then return end
  local coins=p:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") and p.leaderstats:FindFirstChild("SkyCoins");if not coins then return end
  busy[orb]=true
  local power=p:GetAttribute("PetPower") or 0
  local reward=1000000+(power*250000)
  coins.Value+=reward
  orb.Transparency=1;orb.CanTouch=false
  local l=orb:FindFirstChildOfClass("PointLight");if l then l.Enabled=false end
  task.delay(7,function() if orb.Parent then orb.Transparency=0;orb.CanTouch=true;if l then l.Enabled=true end;busy[orb]=nil end end)
 end)
end
for _,folder in ipairs(folders) do if folder then for _,orb in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do hook(orb) end end end
